rules.title: Warfarin + NSAID (e.g. ibuprofen, naproxen)
rules.description: NSAIDs inhibit platelet function and can irritate gastric mucosa; combined with warfarin this sharply raises bleeding risk. Prefer acetaminophen for pain.

rules.title: Warfarin + high vitamin-K foods
rules.description: Large swings in vitamin-K intake (kale, spinach, broccoli, Brussels sprouts) reduce warfarin effect and destabilize INR. Keep leafy-green intake consistent rather than avoiding it.

rules.title: Statin + grapefruit / grapefruit juice
rules.description: Grapefruit inhibits intestinal CYP3A4 and can raise statin levels, increasing muscle-toxicity risk (myalgia, rarely rhabdomyolysis). Seville oranges and pomelos act similarly.

rules.title: Levothyroxine + dairy / calcium / iron
rules.description: Calcium, iron, soy and dairy bind levothyroxine and cut absorption dramatically. Take levothyroxine fasting, 4 hours apart from calcium/iron supplements.

rules.title: Tetracycline-class + dairy / antacids / iron
rules.description: Divalent cations (Ca2+, Mg2+, Fe2+) chelate tetracyclines/doxycycline and can nearly abolish absorption. Separate doses by 2+ hours; take with water not milk.

rules.title: Fluoroquinolone + dairy / mineral supplements
rules.description: Calcium, zinc, magnesium and iron reduce ciprofloxacin/levofloxacin absorption. Take tablet with water 2h before or 6h after minerals.

rules.title: Metformin + alcohol
rules.description: Alcohol potentiates metformin's lactate metabolism effects; heavy use raises lactic acidosis risk and hypoglycemia risk.

rules.title: Insulin + alcohol
rules.description: Alcohol inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis and can cause delayed severe hypoglycemia, especially overnight. Never skip post-dose glucose checks after drinking.

rules.title: ACE inhibitor / ARB + potassium supplements or salt substitutes
rules.description: ACE inhibitors and ARBs raise serum potassium; adding K+ supplements or potassium-based salt substitutes risks dangerous hyperkalemia and arrhythmia.

rules.title: Spironolactone + potassium supplements
rules.description: Potassium-sparing diuretic plus potassium supplementation is a classic hyperkalemia combination; avoid unless explicitly directed with monitoring.

rules.title: SSRI/SNRI + tramadol or triptans
rules.description: Serotonergic combinations raise serotonin-syndrome risk: agitation, hyperreflexia, fever. Watch for early symptoms in the first days of combined use.

rules.title: Opioid + benzodiazepine / sleep aid
rules.description: Boxed-warning combination: profound sedation, respiratory depression, death. If co-prescribed, dose-reduction and supervision are expected.

rules.title: Digoxin + amiodarone
rules.description: Amiodarone raises digoxin plasma levels ~2x via P-gp inhibition; halve digoxin dose and monitor for nausea, visual changes, arrhythmia.

rules.title: Lithium + NSAIDs or thiazide diuretics
rules.description: NSAIDs and thiazides increase lithium reabsorption and can push levels toward toxicity even at stable doses. Any new NSAID course warrants level re-check.

rules.title: Clopidogrel + omeprazole/esomeprazole
rules.description: These PPIs block CYP2C19 activation of clopidogrel, reducing its antiplatelet effect. Pantoprazole is the usual safe alternative.

rules.title: Methotrexate + NSAIDs / alcohol
rules.description: NSAIDs can reduce methotrexate clearance (toxicity: marrow suppression, mucositis); alcohol compounds hepatotoxicity. Weekly labs advised.

rules.title: Nitrates + PDE5 inhibitors (sildenafil/tadalafil)
rules.description: Absolutely contraindicated within 24h (sildenafil) or 48h (tadalafil): catastrophic hypotension and syncope.

rules.title: Carbamazepine + grapefruit
rules.description: Grapefruit components raise carbamazepine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition; diplopia/dizziness may indicate toxicity.

rules.title: Cyclosporine + grapefruit
rules.description: Grapefruit significantly increases cyclosporine exposure; immunosuppressive toxicity affects kidneys. Transplant patients must avoid entirely.

rules.title: Levodopa + high-protein meals
rules.description: Dietary protein competes for intestinal absorption and transport, blunting levodopa effect. Distribute protein evenly; take dose 30 min before meals.

rules.title: Bisphosphonates require strict fasting dosing
rules.description: Alendronate/risedronate absorption is almost abolished by food, calcium or coffee. Take with plain water on empty stomach, stay upright 30 minutes.

rules.title: St John's Wort broad interaction
rules.description: Powerful CYP3A4/P-gp inducer: reduces efficacy of oral contraceptives, cyclosporine, warfarin, many statins and antiretrovirals; serotonergic risk with SSRIs.

rules.title: Ginkgo biloba + anticoagulants / antiplatelets
rules.description: Ginkgo has mild antiplatelet activity; case reports of bleeding when combined with warfarin/aspirin. Avoid unsupervised use.

rules.title: Garlic/ginger supplements + blood thinners
rules.description: High-dose garlic or ginger supplements may add mild antiplatelet effect to anticoagulants; culinary amounts are fine.

rules.title: Two anticoagulants / antiplatelets together
rules.description: Combining DOACs/warfarin/antiplatelets multiplies major bleeding risk unless a clinician deliberately overlaps therapy (e.g., bridging).

rules.title: Beta-blocker + verapamil/diltiazem
rules.description: Additive negative chronotropy/inotropy: bradycardia, heart block, hypotension. Monitor heart rate closely if co-prescribed.

rules.title: MAOI + SSRI/SNRI/tramadol
rules.description: Serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis risk; requires washout periods between classes.

rules.title: Loop diuretics cause potassium loss
rules.description: Furosemide-class drugs waste potassium; hypokalemia increases digoxin toxicity and arrhythmia risk. Dietary K+ or prescribed supplements often needed.
